faq: Will you fix the problems you find?
The audit is a report, not a repair. Many clients then order a fix package or send the list to their own developer. Either way the report is yours to keep and use.
Do you need access to my store?
Staff access with read permissions is enough for most checks. We never change anything during an audit and we never ask for your password.
How is this different from a free site scan?
Automated scans list technical flags. We look at the store as a buyer would, explain which issues cost you sales, and put them in order, so you know what to fix first.
What if I am new to BigCommerce?
That is fine. The report uses everyday words, and the call, if you add it, is a good place to ask questions about how your store is set up.
desc:
A BigCommerce store audit and fix list shows you what is holding your store back, in the order worth fixing. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your design, product pages, checkout, speed and settings, then sends a written report with screenshots and plain instructions.

## What is a BigCommerce store audit?

A BigCommerce store audit is a structured review of your live store by someone who looks at it two ways: as a first-time shopper and as a developer. The result is a written report that lists every problem found, explains why it matters and says how to fix it.

The point is not a long list. The point is a ranked list. Some issues cost you orders every day and take an hour to fix. Others look alarming but change very little. A good audit tells you which is which.

## Why guessing at fixes costs more than reviewing first

Store owners often spend money on the wrong thing. A new theme will not help if the checkout asks for too much. More ad traffic will not help if product pages load slowly on a phone. Without a review, each change is a guess.

An audit replaces guessing with evidence. You see where shoppers are likely to hesitate, which apps are slowing pages, and which settings quietly work against you. You can then spend your time and budget in the right order.

## How an audit improves results

Most store problems fall into a few places: how pages look on mobile, how clear the product page is, how many steps checkout takes, how fast pages load, and whether search engines can read the store. Fixing the biggest friction first removes the reasons visitors leave.

The ranking by effort and impact is the useful part. Quick fixes can be done this week by you or your developer. Larger changes can be planned. Because every finding comes with a screenshot and steps, nothing is left vague. Outcomes still depend on your products and traffic, so the report describes what to change, not what it will earn.

## What a thorough BigCommerce audit covers

- Home page, category pages and product pages, viewed on a phone and on a desktop.
- The cart and checkout walkthrough, including shipping choices and payment options.
- Page speed on key templates, including image size and script weight.
- Installed apps and scripts, and which ones still earn their place.
- Search basics: page titles, headings, descriptions and how the store searches its own catalog.
- Tracking and analytics setup, so you can trust your own numbers.
- Store settings that affect orders, such as tax, shipping zones and email notices.
- Navigation and category structure.
- A comparison against competing stores, in the deeper packages.

## How we run the review

We open your store as a shopper would, adding products to the cart and going through checkout. Then we inspect the theme, apps and settings as a developer would. Every finding is written down with a screenshot, a short reason and a fix step.

We sort the findings by effort and impact and send the report. The Basic package checks your most important pages and ranks the top issues. Standard widens the review to key pages, checkout, search and apps with fix steps. Premium adds a full catalog and settings review, a competitor comparison, a tracking check, a call and a written action plan for the following month.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your main goal, such as more orders, faster pages or fewer abandoned carts.
- Share which pages or products matter most to your business.
- Start with the quick fixes at the top of the list.
- Re-check the store after changes to confirm the fix worked.
- Use the call, if included, to ask about anything unclear.

**Avoid:**
- Fixing low-priority items first because they are easy.
- Making many changes at once, which hides what helped.
- Judging the store only on a desktop screen.
- Ignoring apps you no longer use.
- Treating a free automated scan as a full review.

## Who this is for

This service suits an owner whose sales have stalled and who is unsure why, a store preparing for a busy season that wants a final check, and a new BigCommerce user who inherited a store from a freelancer and wants an honest second opinion.

## What we need from you

The address of your store and a short note on your goals. For a deeper review, we ask to be added as a limited user so we can see settings and reports. We never need your password. The audit itself changes nothing in your store. If you want us to apply the fixes afterward, that is a separate decision you make once you have read the report.
